note: Built from docs.stripe.com/changelog.md on 2026-11-01. Since 2024-09-30.acacia Stripe ships monthly non-breaking versions and two major releases a year whose first version holds the breaking changes. Every dated version before acacia could contain breaking changes. .preview versions are public-preview tracks and are left out. Only breaking entries are listed per version; non-breaking entries are counted.

sdks.source: SDK CHANGELOG.md files on GitHub (master), parsed for the pinned API version stated in each release; https://docs.stripe.com/sdks/versioning says each SDK version uses the API version current at its release.
sdks.note: apiVersionAtRelease is the version pinned by x.0.0; latestApiVersionInMajor is the newest GA version a minor of that major pinned (from changelog text). Majors from 2022-08 onward.

openapiTags.note: stripe/openapi tags are sequential release numbers (v1, v2, ... v2596), not API versions. Each tag snapshots the spec at that moment; openapi/spec3.json info.version names the API version it describes. Since v2191 (2026-03-11) release notes list info.version per spec file. The table maps each GA API version to the last tag whose openapi/spec3.json info.version still equalled it (found by reading info.version at tags). Note: the public openapi/spec3.json info.version can lag the SDK spec (spec3.sdk.json) by one monthly version.

versions.note: No tag yet has openapi/spec3.json info.version = this version (master still says 2026-09-30.endive on 2026-11-01, while spec3.sdk.json says 2026-10-28.endive). Use master.
